observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a pair of white 2.0 desktop/computer speakers with twin drivers each, a volume knob and blue LED indicator on the right unit, connected to each other by a cable - typical of a Logitech multimedia speaker set, not a portable all-in-one Bluetooth speaker.
Photo 1 shows a 'logi' logo printed on the base of the left speaker.

Photo 2 is a close-up of the power adapter's rating label, embossed with '2207 Rich Stereo Sound with Bluetooth', 'Model: S-0016...', FCC ID JNZS00168, and Logitech Europe S.A. address in Switzerland/Netherlands.
No close-up of the speaker's rear ports, no photo of the unit powered on and playing, no photo of the UK plug/adapter pins or any crackle/sound test.
Watermark 'DEALS MASTER GLOBAL LIMITED' overlays the photos, suggesting a reseller/dealer listing rather than a private owner's own photos.

claims.claim: Great condition with powerful clean sound
claims.evidence: No audio/video clip provided; sound quality cannot be judged from still photos.

claims.claim: Can be used with your laptop or other devices
claims.evidence: Plausible given the product type (Z207 supports both Bluetooth and aux-in) but no port/cable or pairing screenshot shown.
No video of knob/power button being operated; LED is lit in photo 1 but that only shows power, not full function.
Photo 2 shows the power adapter itself with its rating label.
Audio defects cannot be assessed from photos; would need a sound clip at volume.
No UK receipt, box, or UK-spec plug photo provided; adapter label shows FCC/IC/NOM marks typical of a US/international adapter, not UK-specific.

risks.risk: Speaker drivers could be damaged, rattling, or producing crackle/distortion at volume
risks.proof: A short video clip of both speakers playing audio at moderate-to-high volume
risks.if_unproven: priced as if one or both drivers are faulty

risks.risk: Bluetooth module may not pair or may drop connection
risks.proof: A screen-recording or photo of a phone/laptop successfully paired and playing over Bluetooth
risks.if_unproven: priced as Bluetooth non-functional, aux-only use assumed

risks.risk: Power adapter plug type may not be Nigeria/UK compatible (adapter label shows FCC/IC/NOM marks, suggesting a US-market adapter) requiring an extra plug adapter
risks.proof: A clear photo of the adapter's plug pins/head
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming buyer needs to source a compatible plug adapter

risks.risk: Volume knob or headphone/mic jack switches may be worn or non-functional
risks.proof: A close-up video of the knob being turned and any front switches being pressed

proof_requests: A video clip of the speakers playing music at volume to confirm no crackle/dead driver
A photo or screen-recording of the speaker successfully paired via Bluetooth to a phone/laptop
A clear photo of the adapter's plug head/pins to confirm compatibility with Nigerian sockets
A close-up of the rear ports (AUX, power in) to confirm no damage or corrosion
response.reason: The item is a Logitech Z207 computer speaker set, a different product category from the comparables listed, which are all portable all-in-one Bluetooth speakers (Bose SoundLink, Sony, Sonos Roam, etc.); none of these are suitable price comparables for a Z207 desktop speaker pair.
